/**
 * Home
 * Built by FlowCode from the app model; it reads and writes the app's store and look-up layer (src/app/).
 */
import { CatalogSearch, CategoryIndex, LookupCatalog } from "../sections/LookupCatalog";
import { ZipPrompt } from "../sections/PlaceFinder";
import { go } from "../app/routes";
import { lookup } from "../app/lookup";

export default function LandingScreen() {
  return (
    <div className="fl-lkf-stack">
      {/* 1. Hero: Clean Cart, its promise and the search (design step: compose this from the PRD's words) */}
      <section className="fl-lkf-hero" aria-labelledby="landing-title">
        <h1 id="landing-title">{"Clean Cart"}</h1>
        
        <CatalogSearch lookup={lookup} onSearch={(s) => go("catalog", `q=${s}`)} onOpen={(id) => go("product", id)} />
      </section>
      {/* 2. Where to find it: the ZIP code */}
      <ZipPrompt lookup={lookup} />
      {/* 3. Categories */}
      <CategoryIndex lookup={lookup} onCategory={(c) => go("catalog", c)} />
      {/* 4. The most liked */}
      <LookupCatalog lookup={lookup} title="Most liked" pageSize={8} toolbar={false} onOpen={(id) => go("product", id)} />
    </div>
  );
}
